(a) it              (b) this            (c) these         (d) that

What is literacy? It is the golden key that (443)_______ the gates to a whole new world. It heralds the dawn of a new (444)______. But  the  media  hype  seems  to  give  the impression that literacy simply  means  the  ability to sign one's name, instead of putting thumb  impression. Isn't that a very  (445)______,  simplistic interpretation of the word? Taking up this narrow meaning of the word,  politicians  proclaim that their states have achieved 80 or 90  per  cent  literacy  or  even  (446)______.  But  quite  often,  what happens  is, once the training course is over,  to  produce (447)______, the neo-literates soon lapse into illiteracy.
- Q.443. (a) controls    (b) opens    (c) leads    (d) closes
- Q.444. (a) day   (b) year     (c) month    (d) season

When  Prime  Minister  Narendra  Modi  announced  that  rupees with  the  denominations of 500/- and 1000/- would (448).______ to  be  the  legal  tender  from  the  9th  of  November,  the  whole country  was  stunned.  This  decision  caused  a  sensation  in the whole  country.  Social  media  was  flooded  with  messages  and
information. People started counting the cash they had (449).______  for  years  legally  or  illegally.  The  main objective of this move was to curb black money, corruption and fake money menace. All  the  people  but  those  who indulged in (450).______ welcomed the move. The whole opposition shook hands against this  move  under  one  pretence  or  the  other.  They  called  this decision a (451).______ law and wanted the government to roll it back.  Severe  criticisms  were  made  to  target  the  decision. The government also carried out (452).______ attacks.
Q.448. (a) unify   (b) cease   (c) seize   (d) collaborate
- Q.449. (a) withdrawn

Organic agriculture offers a means  to substitute costlier agricultural  inputs  such  as  HYV seeds, chemical fertilisers and pesticides with locally produced organic inputs that are cheaper and  thereby  generate  good  returns  on  (453)_______.  Organic agriculture also generates income  through  exports  as  the demand for organically grown crops is on a (454)______. Studies across  countries  have  shown  that  organically  grown  food  has more nutritional value than chemical farming, thus providing us with  healthy foods. Since organic farming requires more labour input than (455)______ farming, India will find organic farming an attractive  (456)______.  Finally,  the produce is pesticide-free and produced in an environmentally (457)______ way.
Q.453. (a) investment  (b) expenditure  (c) profit  (d) loss
Q.454. (a) stagnation   (b) decline   (c) rise   (d) growth
